expanded_prompts.normal-prompt-v2.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: an original full-body creature sprite for a hand-drawn 2D creature-raising game.
Create exactly one isolated creature from this independent design brief. Use clear dark colored variable-weight outlines, clean three-step cel shading, soft upper-left light, restrained material texture. No photorealism or 3D render.
Technical canvas: exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels, PNG RGBA with genuine transparent alpha. Center the entire creature with its longest extent between 768 and 896 pixels; leave at least 64 fully transparent pixels on every side. Transparent background, no checkerboard, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow halo, text, lettering, labels, logo, watermark, border, costume, held objects or extra creatures. Body glow must stay inside its contour. Avoid human forms and recognizable existing characters.

Body and exact anatomy: A single horizontally broad elliptical frosted-glass body, exactly four short rounded legs and exactly one low rear fin. Exactly two simple small dark eyes together at the image-right front; no mouth. The low rear fin is one solid tapered soft-glass ridge, not a wing or tail.
Fixed counts: eyes 2, feet 4, wings 0, tails 0.
Palette placement: body #D89B52; legs and rear fin #5B9BA5; restrained highlights #F1D9E7.
Pose: Stand low and calmly, slight top-down three-quarter view facing image-right. Arrange four short legs so their four endpoints are countable.
Keep every declared part clearly countable; do not add other parts. This must be one full-body sprite only.
expanded_prompts.normal-repair-attempt002-prompt.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1 is the edit target and exact identity reference: one broad elliptical amber frosted-glass creature, two small dark eyes on its image-right front, teal short legs, one low teal rear fin, pale pink accents.
Make two targeted corrections while retaining this same approved design_version 2 creature.
Correction 1, anatomy visibility: There must be exactly FOUR separate short rounded teal legs and FOUR clearly separated foot endpoints, all visibly connected to the underside. The current reference only shows three endpoints. Adjust the view to a higher slight top-down three-quarter angle and spread its four short legs outward just enough that no endpoint is hidden by the oval body or another leg. Show two legs on the far side as well as two legs on the near side: one foreleg and one hindleg on each side. Four distinct feet must be countable at a glance around the oval. This is a quadruped, not a tripod. Keep the body low and horizontal and facing image-right. Retain exactly ONE low rear fin at the back (image-left); keep that fin visibly distinct from the four supporting legs. Do not turn the fin into another foot or tail.
Correction 2, rendering style: Replace the smooth glossy gradient shading with clean, flat hand-drawn 2D GAME CEL SHADING. Use one flat base tone, one flat shadow shape, and one restrained flat light shape per material. Matte frosted glass impression. Remove long glossy white streaks, painterly gradients, sparkles, surface noise and 3D-render sheen. Preserve dark clean variable-weight contour and soft upper-left lighting through these discrete shapes.
Invariants: same horizontally broad single elliptical body, same two eyes and no mouth, exactly four short rounded legs, exactly one low rear fin, zero wings and zero tail, same amber main body #D89B52, teal legs/fin #5B9BA5, pale pink accent #F1D9E7. Do not add a head, arms, horns or other anatomy. Keep the calm low stance.
Asset: one full-body 2D creature sprite. Center with ample genuine transparent padding, no cropped parts. Intended delivery canvas 1024x1024 RGBA, silhouette maximum 896 pixels and minimum 64 transparent pixels padding. No background, painted checkerboard, ground plane, cast shadow, glow halo, labels, text, watermark, border, other characters or scenery.
The two actual corrections are visible four-legged anatomy and flat cel shading. Preserve the other identity features; do not redesign the creature.
expanded_prompts.normal-repair-attempt003-localized-promp:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target. Make ONLY the following localized correction to the visible appendage count. This is an existing original creature whose established identity must remain intact.
Add exactly ONE short rounded teal supporting leg projecting beyond the upper-right far outline of the amber ellipse, around source coordinates x=925,y=375. The leg must have a rounded foot endpoint clearly visible outside the oval contour and connect naturally behind the body to its underside. Preserve the THREE existing supporting legs along the lower contour untouched. The added leg makes FOUR visible supporting legs total. Preserve the one low teal rear fin at upper-left exactly as it is; that fin is not a supporting leg and must not be counted as one. Do not add another new leg. Preserve the two eyes and the improved simple flat shading.
Do not move, remove, hide, merge or duplicate any existing body part. Do not rotate the body or change the viewing angle. Keep the body silhouette, eye positions, material, texture and palette unchanged except for the specifically requested missing supporting foot/feet. Keep all new feet short and broad like the existing ones, not long arms or wings. Every intended foot endpoint must be visibly separate. No changes to the eyes, no mouth, no wings, no tail.
One full-body isolated creature, same scale and composition, genuine transparent RGBA background. No text, arrows, digits, selection marks, labels, logos, added scenery, ground, cast shadow, halo, or checkerboard. Leave the image otherwise unchanged.
expanded_prompts.pixel-prompt-attempt001.txt:
Use case: style-transfer
Input image 1 is the exact corrected normal illustration identity reference. Redraw this SAME creature as deliberate authentic game pixel art. Change only the rendering medium. Never downsample, pixelation-filter or redesign the creature.
Locked anatomy: A single horizontally broad elliptical frosted-glass body, exactly four short rounded legs and exactly one low rear fin. Exactly two simple small dark eyes together at the image-right front; no mouth. The low rear fin is one solid tapered soft-glass ridge, not a wing or tail.
Locked counts: {"eyes": 2, "feet": 4, "wings": 0, "tails": 0}
Locked palette roles: body #D89B52; legs and rear fin #5B9BA5; restrained highlights #F1D9E7
Locked pose: Match the reference exactly, including every now-visible foot, far-side appendage, three-quarter facing and all material identifier marks. Every declared foot must remain visible and countable, with no hidden, merged, added or deleted feet.
Rendering contract: a native 128 by 128 pixel PNG RGBA sprite on an exact 128 by 128 integer pixel grid. No more than 32 total visible colors. Only fully opaque pixels (alpha 255) and fully transparent pixels (alpha 0). Every edge must use carefully placed hard square pixel clusters and controlled staircase contours; no antialiasing, smooth curves, gradients, blur, glows, semitransparency, subpixel edges or arbitrary block sizes. 1–2 logical pixel dark contour. Flat limited-color shading and intentional readable clusters, not a tiny painted illustration.
Composition: same body silhouette, relative dimensions, facing and identity as reference, full body centered. Longest extent 96–112 logical pixels, at least 8 transparent pixels on every side. If a larger canvas is unavoidable, it must be a pixel-perfect exact integer enlargement of the same 128x128 logical image, with every logical pixel an identical size opaque square. Preserve the exact geometry of a 128x128 grid.
No text, labels, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, background, drawn checkerboard, ground, cast shadow, frame, scenery, new appendages or other creatures. Translate translucent or glossy cues to opaque limited-color clusters; do not make holes in the body. Produce one sprite only.
